msgid:
While Gmsh can create and manipulate geometries interactively, it is in
no way a full-fledged replacement for an advanced CAD system.

msgctxt: doc/texinfo/gmsh.texi|Geometry module|paragraph|each volume must possess a unique tag.#2
msgid:
Model entities can be manipulated and transformed in a variety of ways
within the geometry module, but operations are always performed directly
within their respective CAD kernels. As explained above, there is no
common internal geometrical representation: rather, Gmsh directly
performs the operations (translation, rotation, intersection, union,
fragments, ...) on the native geometrical representation using each CAD
kernel's own API.  In the same philosophy, models can be imported in the
geometry module through each CAD kernel's own import mechanisms. For
example, by default Gmsh imports STEP and IGES files through
OpenCASCADE, which will lead to the creation of model entities with an
internal OpenCASCADE representation. Models represented with the
built-in CAD kernel can be serialized to disk by exporting them as
@file{.geo_unrolled} files, while models contructed with the OpenCASCADE
kernel can be serialized as @file{.brep} or @file{.xao} files.
reference_translation: 模型实体可以在几何模块中通过多种方式进行操作和变换，但所有操作始终直接在各自的 CAD 内核中执行。如上所述，不存在通用的内部几何表示；Gmsh 使用每个 CAD 内核自身的 API，在原生几何表示上直接执行这些操作（平移、旋转、求交、并集、分片等）。同样，模型也可以通过各 CAD 内核自身的导入机制导入几何模块。例如，默认情况下，Gmsh 通过 OpenCASCADE 导入 STEP 和 IGES 文件，这将创建带有内部 OpenCASCADE 表示的模型实体。使用内置 CAD 内核表示的模型可以通过导出为 @file{.geo_unrolled} 文件序列化到磁盘，而使用 OpenCASCADE 内核构建的模型可以序列化为 @file{.brep} 或 @file{.xao} 文件。
semantic_key: each volume must possess a unique tag.#2

msgctxt: doc/texinfo/gmsh.texi|Structured grids|paragraph|Extrude @{ Surface @{ @var{expression-list} @}; @var{layers} < Using Index[@var{expr}]; > < Using View[@var{expr}]; > < ScaleLastLayer; > @}#2
msgid:
The advantage of this approach is that it provides a topological
description of the boundary layer, which means that it can be connected
to other geometrical entities. The disadvantage is that the mesh is just
a ``simple'' extrusion: no fans, no special treatments of reentrant
corners, etc. Another boundary layer algorithm is currently available
through the @code{BoundaryLayer} field (@pxref{Specifying mesh element
sizes}). It only works in 2D however, and is a meshing constraint: it
works directly at the mesh level, without creating geometrical
entities. See
e.g. @url{@value{GITLAB-PREFIX}/benchmarks/2d/BL0.geo,BL0.geo} or
@url{@value{GITLAB-PREFIX}/benchmarks/2d/naca12_2d.geo,naca12_2d.geo}.
reference_translation:
这种方法的优点是，它提供了边界层的拓扑描述，因此可以将其连接到其他几何实体。缺点是，网格只是一次“简单”的拉伸：没有扇形处理，也没有对内凹角等进行特殊处理。目前还可以通过 @code{BoundaryLayer} 字段使用另一种边界层算法（@pxref{Specifying mesh element
sizes}）。不过，它只能在 2D 中工作，并且属于网格剖分约束：它直接在网格层面工作，不会创建几何实体。有关示例，请参见 @url{@value{GITLAB-PREFIX}/benchmarks/2d/BL0.geo,BL0.geo} 或 @url{@value{GITLAB-PREFIX}/benchmarks/2d/naca12_2d.geo,naca12_2d.geo}。
semantic_key: Extrude @{ Surface @{ @var{expression-list} @}; @var{layers} < Using Index[@var{expr}]; > < Using View[@var{expr}]; > < ScaleLastLayer; > @}#2

msgctxt: doc/texinfo/gmsh.texi|Structured grids|paragraph|Extrude @{ Surface @{ @var{expression-list} @}; @var{layers} < Using Index[@var{expr}]; > < Using View[@var{expr}]; > < ScaleLastLayer; > @}
msgid:
Extrude a ``topological'' boundary layer from the specified surfaces. If
no view is specified, the mesh of the boundary layer entities is created
using a gouraud-shaded (smoothed) normal field. If a scalar view is
specified, it locally prescribes the thickness of the layer. If a
vector-valued view is specified it locally prescribes both the extrusion
direction and the thickness. Specifying a boundary layer index allows to
extrude several independent boundary layers (with independent normal
smoothing). @code{ScaleLastLayer} scales the height of the last (top)
layer of each normal's extrusion by the average length of the edges in
all the source elements that contain the source node (actually, the
average of the averages for each element--edges actually touching the
source node are counted twice). This allows the height of the last layer
to vary along with the size of the source elements in order to achieve
better element quality. For example, in a boundary layer extruded with
the Layers definition 'Layers@{ @{1,4,2@}, @{0.5, 0.6, 1.6@} @},' a
source node adjacent to elements with an overall average edge length of
5.0 will extrude to have a last layer height = (1.6-0.6) * 5.0 =
5.0. Topological boundary layers are only available with the built-in
kernel. See
@url{@value{GITLAB-PREFIX}/benchmarks/extrude/sphere_boundary_layer.geo,sphere_boundary_layer.geo}
or
@url{@value{GITLAB-PREFIX}/benchmarks/extrude/sphere_boundary_layer_from_view.geo,sphere_boundary_layer_from_view.geo}
for @file{.geo} file examples, and
@url{@value{GITLAB-PREFIX}/examples/api/aneurysm.py,aneurysm.py} for an API
example.
reference_translation: 从指定曲面拉伸出拓扑边界层。如果未指定视图，则使用 Gouraud 着色（平滑）的法向场创建边界层实体的网格。如果指定了标量视图，则由它局部规定边界层的厚度。如果指定了向量值视图，则由它局部规定拉伸方向和厚度。指定边界层索引后，可以拉伸出多个相互独立的边界层（具有独立的法向平滑处理）。@code{ScaleLastLayer} 根据包含源节点的所有源单元中边的平均长度，缩放每个法向拉伸的最后一层（顶部层）的高度（实际上是每个单元平均值的平均值——实际接触源节点的边计数两次）。这样可以使最后一层的高度随源单元尺寸变化，从而获得更好的单元质量。例如，对于使用 Layers 定义 'Layers@{ @{1,4,2@}, @{0.5, 0.6, 1.6@} @},' 拉伸的边界层，如果某个源节点邻接的单元的总体平均边长为 5.0，则拉伸得到的最后一层高度 = (1.6-0.6) * 5.0 = 5.0。拓扑边界层仅适用于内置内核。示例请参见 @url{@value{GITLAB-PREFIX}/benchmarks/extrude/sphere_boundary_layer.geo,sphere_boundary_layer.geo} 或 @url{@value{GITLAB-PREFIX}/benchmarks/extrude/sphere_boundary_layer_from_view.geo,sphere_boundary_layer_from_view.geo}（均为 @file{.geo} 文件），API 示例请参见 @url{@value{GITLAB-PREFIX}/examples/api/aneurysm.py,aneurysm.py}。
semantic_key: Extrude @{ Surface @{ @var{expression-list} @}; @var{layers} < Using Index[@var{expr}]; > < Using View[@var{expr}]; > < ScaleLastLayer; > @}

msgid:
Create a spline or a BSpline from control points sampled on the curves
in @var{expression-list}. @code{Using} @var{expression} specifies the
number of intervals on each curve to compute the sampling
points. Compound splines and BSplines are only available with the
built-in geometry kernel.
reference_translation: 根据在 @var{expression-list} 中的曲线上采样得到的控制点，创建样条曲线或 BSpline。@code{Using} @var{expression} 指定在每条曲线上计算采样点时使用的区间数。复合样条曲线和 BSplines 仅可与内置几何内核配合使用。

msgid: Optional rules are enclosed in @code{<} @code{>} pairs.

msgid:
Print a string expression in the information window and/or on the
terminal. @code{Printf} is equivalent to the @code{printf} C function:
@var{string-expression} is a format string that can contain formatting
characters (@code{%f}, @code{%e}, etc.). Note that all
@w{@var{expression}s} are evaluated as floating point values in Gmsh
(@pxref{Floating point expressions}), so that only valid floating point
formatting characters make sense in @var{string-expression}. See @ref{t5},
for an example of the use of @code{Printf}.
reference_translation: 在信息窗口和/或终端中输出字符串表达式。@code{Printf} 等价于 C 函数 @code{printf}：@var{string-expression} 是一种格式字符串，可以包含格式化字符（@code{%f}、@code{%e} 等）。请注意，所有 @w{@var{expression}s} 在 Gmsh 中都按浮点值求值（@pxref{Floating point expressions}），因此 @var{string-expression} 中只有有效的浮点格式字符才有意义。示例请参见 @ref{t5}，其中使用了 @code{Printf}。
（严格来说，这不是一种变换。）返回基本实体边界上的所有几何点。可用于计算复杂部分的边界。@value{SYNC}

msgid: Add a string to a list-based post-processing view with tag @code{tag}. If @code{coord} contains 3 coordinates the string is positioned in the 3D model space ("3D string"); if it contains 2 coordinates it is positioned in the 2D graphics viewport ("2D string"). @code{data} contains one or more (for multistep views) strings. @code{style} contains key-value pairs of styling parameters, concatenated. Available keys are "Font" (possible values: "Times-Roman", "Times-Bold", "Times-Italic", "Times-BoldItalic", "Helvetica", "Helvetica-Bold", "Helvetica-Oblique", "Helvetica-BoldOblique", "Courier", "Courier-Bold", "Courier-Oblique", "Courier-BoldOblique", "Symbol", "ZapfDingbats", "Screen"), "FontSize" and "Align" (possible values: "Left" or "BottomLeft", "Center" or "BottomCenter", "Right" or "BottomRight", "TopLeft", "TopCenter", "TopRight", "CenterLeft", "CenterCenter", "CenterRight").
reference_translation: 向带有标签 @code{tag} 的基于列表的后处理视图添加字符串。如果 @code{coord} 包含 3 个坐标，则将字符串放置在 3D 模型空间中（"3D string"）；如果包含 2 个坐标，则将其放置在 2D 图形视口中（"2D string"）。@code{data} 包含一个或多个字符串（对于多步视图）。@code{style} 包含串接的样式参数键值对。可用的键包括 "Font"（可能的值："Times-Roman"、"Times-Bold"、"Times-Italic"、"Times-BoldItalic"、"Helvetica"、"Helvetica-Bold"、"Helvetica-Oblique"、"Helvetica-BoldOblique"、"Courier"、"Courier-Bold"、"Courier-Oblique"、"Courier-BoldOblique"、"Symbol"、"ZapfDingbats"、"Screen"）、"FontSize" 和 "Align"（可能的值："Left" 或 "BottomLeft"、"Center" 或 "BottomCenter"、"Right" 或 "BottomRight"、"TopLeft"、"TopCenter"、"TopRight"、"CenterLeft"、"CenterCenter"、"CenterRight"）。

msgid: Get the color of the model entity of dimension @code{dim} and tag @code{tag}. If no color is specified for the entity, return fully transparent blue, i.e. (0, 0, 255, 0).
reference_translation: 获取维度 @code{dim}、标签 @code{tag} 的模型实体颜色。如果未为该实体指定颜色，则返回完全透明的蓝色，即 (0, 0, 255, 0)。

msgid: Get the @code{value} of a numerical option. @code{name} is of the form "Category.Option" or "Category[num].Option". Available categories and options are listed in the @url{https://gmsh.info/doc/texinfo/gmsh.html#Gmsh-options,"Gmsh options" chapter of the Gmsh reference manual}.
reference_translation: 获取数值选项的 @code{value}。@code{name} 的形式为 "Category.Option" 或 "Category[num].Option"。可用的类别和选项见 @url{https://gmsh.info/doc/texinfo/gmsh.html#Gmsh-options,Gmsh 参考手册的“Gmsh 选项”一章}。

msgid: Compute the boolean intersection (the common parts) of the entities @code{objectDimTags} and @code{toolDimTags} (vectors of (dim, tag) pairs) in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation. Return the resulting entities in @code{outDimTags}, and the correspondance between input and resulting entities in @code{outDimTagsMap}. If @code{tag} is positive, try to set the tag explicitly (only valid if the boolean operation results in a single entity). Remove the object if @code{removeObject} is set. Remove the tool if @code{removeTool} is set.
reference_translation: 在 OpenCASCADE CAD 表示中，计算实体 @code{objectDimTags} 和 @code{toolDimTags} 的布尔交集（公共部分），其中二者是由 (dim, tag) 对组成的向量。将结果实体返回到 @code{outDimTags}，并将输入实体与结果实体之间的对应关系返回到 @code{outDimTagsMap}。如果 @code{tag} 为正，尝试显式设置标签（仅当布尔操作产生单个实体时有效）。设置 @code{removeObject} 时删除对象。设置 @code{removeTool} 时删除工具。

msgid: Fillet the volumes @code{volumeTags} on the curves @code{curveTags} with radii @code{radii}. The @code{radii} vector can either contain a single radius, as many radii as @code{curveTags}, or twice as many as @code{curveTags} (in which case different radii are provided for the begin and end points of the curves). Return the filleted entities in @code{outDimTags} as a vector of (dim, tag) pairs. Remove the original volume if @code{removeVolume} is set.
reference_translation: 对体 @code{volumeTags} 的曲线 @code{curveTags} 使用半径 @code{radii} 进行圆角处理。@code{radii} 向量可以包含单个半径、与 @code{curveTags} 中元素数量相同的多个半径，或数量为 @code{curveTags} 中元素数量两倍的半径（此时为曲线的起点和终点分别提供不同半径）。将圆角处理后的实体作为由 (dim, tag) 对组成的向量返回到 @code{outDimTags}。设置 @code{removeVolume} 时删除原始体。

msgid: Add a spline (Catmull-Rom) curve in the built-in CAD representation, going through the points @code{pointTags}. If @code{tag} is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Create a periodic curve if the first and last points are the same. Return the tag of the spline curve.
reference_translation: 在内置 CAD 表示中添加一条样条曲线（Catmull-Rom），该曲线穿过点 @code{pointTags}。如果 @code{tag} 为正，则显式设置该标签；否则自动选择新标签。如果第一个点和最后一个点相同，则创建周期曲线。返回样条曲线的标签。

msgid:
Linearly interpolate between data provided on a 3D rectangular structured grid.@*
@*
The format of the input file is:@*
@*
  Ox Oy Oz @*
  Dx Dy Dz @*
  nx ny nz @*
  v(0,0,0) v(0,0,1) v(0,0,2) ... @*
  v(0,1,0) v(0,1,1) v(0,1,2) ... @*
  v(0,2,0) v(0,2,1) v(0,2,2) ... @*
  ...      ...      ... @*
  v(1,0,0) ...      ... @*
@*
where O are the coordinates of the first node, D are the distances between nodes in each direction, n are the numbers of nodes in each direction, and v are the values on each node.@*
@*
Options:@*
reference_translation:
在三维矩形结构化网格上对给定数据进行线性插值。@*
@*
输入文件的格式为：@*
@*
  Ox Oy Oz @*
  Dx Dy Dz @*
  nx ny nz @*
  v(0,0,0) v(0,0,1) v(0,0,2) ... @*
  v(0,1,0) v(0,1,1) v(0,1,2) ... @*
  v(0,2,0) v(0,2,1) v(0,2,2) ... @*
  ...      ...      ... @*
  v(1,0,0) ...      ... @*
@*
其中 O 是第一个节点的坐标，D 是各个方向上节点之间的距离，n 是各个方向上的节点数，v 是每个节点上的值。@*
@*
选项：@*

msgid:
Plugin(HarmonicToTime) takes the values in the time steps `RealPart' and `ImaginaryPart' of the view `View', and creates a new view containing@*
@*
`View'[`RealPart'] * cos(p) +- `View'[`ImaginaryPart'] * sin(p)@*
with@*
 p = 2*Pi*k/`NumSteps', k = 0, ..., `NumSteps'-1@*
and 'NumSteps' the total number of time steps@*
over 'NumPeriods' periods at frequency 'Frequency' [Hz].@*
The '+' sign is used if `TimeSign'>0, the '-' sign otherwise.@*
@*
If `View' < 0, the plugin is run on the current view.@*
@*
Plugin(HarmonicToTime) creates one new list-based view.
Numeric options:
reference_translation:
Plugin(HarmonicToTime) 获取视图 `View' 在时间步 `RealPart' 和 `ImaginaryPart' 处的值，并创建一个包含以下结果的新视图：@*
@*
`View'[`RealPart'] * cos(p) +- `View'[`ImaginaryPart'] * sin(p)@*
其中@*
 p = 2*Pi*k/`NumSteps', k = 0, ..., `NumSteps'-1@*
且 'NumSteps' 是总时间步数，@*
即在频率为 'Frequency' [Hz] 下跨越 'NumPeriods' 个周期。@*
当 `TimeSign'>0 时使用 '+' 号，否则使用 '-' 号。@*
@*
如果 `View' < 0，则插件在当前视图上运行。@*
@*
Plugin(HarmonicToTime) 创建一个新的基于列表的视图。
数值选项：

msgid:
Plugin(Smooth) averages the values at the nodes of the view `View'.@*
@*
If `View' < 0, the plugin is run on the current view.@*
@*
Plugin(Smooth) is executed in-place.
Numeric options:
reference_translation:
Plugin(Smooth) 对视图 `View' 各节点处的值求平均。@*
@*
如果 `View' < 0，则插件在当前视图上运行。@*
@*
Plugin(Smooth) 就地执行。
数值选项：

msgid:
Plugin(MinMax) computes the min/max of a view.@*
@*
If `View' < 0, the plugin is run on the current view. If `OverTime' = 1, the plugin calculates the min/max over space and time. If `Argument' = 1, the plugin calculates the min/max and the argmin/argmax. If `Visible' = 1, the plugin is only applied to visible entities.@*
@*
Plugin(MinMax) creates two new list-based views.
Numeric options:
reference_translation:
Plugin(MinMax) 计算某个视图的 min/max。@*
@*
如果 `View' < 0，则插件在当前视图上运行。如果 `OverTime' = 1，则插件计算空间和时间上的 min/max。如果 `Argument' = 1，则插件计算 min/max 以及 argmin/argmax。如果 `Visible' = 1，则插件仅应用于可见实体。@*
@*
Plugin(MinMax) 创建两个新的基于列表的视图。
数值选项：

msgid:
Plugin(SpanningTree) builds a tree spanning every vertex of a mesh and stores it directly in the model.@*
The tree is constructed by starting first on the curves, then on the surfaces and finally on the volumes.@*
@*
Parameters@*
- PhysicalVolumes: list of the physical volumes upon which the tree must be built.@*
- PhysicalSurfaces: list of the physical surfaces upon which the tree must be built.@*
- PhysicalCurves: list of the physical curves upon which the tree must be built.@*
- OutputPhysical: physical tag of the generated tree (-1 will select a new tag automatically).@*
@*
Note - Lists must be comma separated integers and spaces are ignored.@*
Remark - This plugin does not overwrite a physical group.Therefore, if an existing physical tag is used in OutputPhysical, the edges of the tree will be /added/ to the specified group.
String options:
reference_translation:
Plugin(SpanningTree) 构建一棵覆盖网格每个顶点的树，并将其直接存储在模型中。@*
该树构建时先处理曲线，再处理曲面，最后处理体。@*
@*
参数@*
- PhysicalVolumes：必须在其上构建该树的物理体列表。@*
- PhysicalSurfaces：必须在其上构建该树的物理曲面列表。@*
- PhysicalCurves：必须在其上构建该树的物理曲线列表。@*
- OutputPhysical：生成树的物理标签（-1 将自动选择新标签）。@*
@*
注意：列表必须由逗号分隔的整数组成，空格将被忽略。@*
备注：此插件不会覆盖物理组。因此，如果 OutputPhysical 中使用了现有物理标签，树的边将被添加到指定组中。
字符串选项：

msgid:
Plugin(SphericalRaise) transforms the coordinates of the elements in the view `View' using the values associated with the `TimeStep'-th time step.@*
@*
Instead of elevating the nodes along the X, Y and Z axes as with the View[`View'].RaiseX, View[`View'].RaiseY and View[`View'].RaiseZ options, the raise is applied along the radius of a sphere centered at (`Xc', `Yc', `Zc').@*
@*
To produce a standard radiation pattern, set `Offset' to minus the radius of the sphere the original data lives on.@*
@*
If `View' < 0, the plugin is run on the current view.@*
@*
Plugin(SphericalRaise) is executed in-place.
Numeric options:
reference_translation:
Plugin(SphericalRaise) 使用与第 `TimeStep' 个时间步相关联的值变换视图 `View' 中网格单元的坐标。@*
@*
不同于使用 View[`View'].RaiseX、View[`View'].RaiseY 和 View[`View'].RaiseZ 选项沿 X、Y 和 Z 轴抬升节点，这里的抬升沿以 (`Xc', `Yc', `Zc') 为中心的球体半径方向进行。@*
@*
要生成标准辐射图样，请将 `Offset' 设置为原始数据所在球体半径的负值。@*
@*
如果 `View' < 0，则插件在当前视图上运行。@*
@*
Plugin(SphericalRaise) 就地执行。
数值选项：

msgid:
Plugin(Summation) sums every time steps of 'Reference View' and (every) 'Other View X'and store the result in a new view.@*
If 'View 0' < 0 then the current view is selected.@*
If 'View 1...8' < 0 then this view is skipped.@*
Views can have different number of time steps@*
Warning: the Plugin assume that every views sharethe same mesh and that meshes do not move between time steps!
String options:
reference_translation:
Plugin(Summation) 将 'Reference View' 和（每个）'Other View X' 的所有时间步相加，并将结果存储在新视图中。@*
如果 'View 0' < 0，则选择当前视图。@*
如果 'View 1...8' < 0，则跳过此视图。@*
视图可以有不同数量的时间步。@*
警告：该插件假定所有视图共享同一网格，并且网格在时间步之间不会移动！
字符串选项：

msgctxt: doc/texinfo/gmsh.texi|Mesh module questions|paragraph|How can I remove mesh nodes for geometrical construction points (centers of spheres, etc.) from output mesh file?
msgid:
By default Gmsh saves all the geometrical entities and their associated
mesh. In particular, since each geometry point is meshed with a point
element, defined by a mesh node, the output file will contain one 0-D
mesh element and one mesh node for each geometry point. To remove such
elements/nodes from the mesh, simply define physical groups for the
entities you want to save (see previous question).
reference_translation: 默认情况下，Gmsh 会保存所有几何实体及其关联网格。特别是，每个几何点都会生成一个点单元，该单元由一个网格节点定义。因此，输出文件中每个几何点都对应一个 0-D 网格单元和一个网格节点。若要从网格中移除这类单元/节点，只需为要保存的实体定义物理组（参见上一问题）。
semantic_key: How can I remove mesh nodes for geometrical construction points (centers of spheres, etc.) from output mesh file?

msgctxt: doc/texinfo/gmsh.texi|Geometry module questions|paragraph|Gmsh is very slow when I use many transformations (Translate, Rotate, Symmetry, Extrude, etc.) with the built-in CAD kernel. What's wrong?
msgid:
The default behavior of Gmsh is to check and suppress all duplicate
entities (points, curves and surfaces) each time a transformation
command is issued with the built-in CAD kernel. This can slow down
things a lot if many transformations are performed. There are two
solutions to this problem:
